pages.text: Any tamed adult bug can wear any bug armour. $(thing)Right-click$() your pet with it to put it on, $(thing)shears$() take it off. Each one adds armour and a small perk from its meteor's set.
pages.title: Bug Armour

pages.text: Monsters only notice the pet from close by, unless it hits them.
pages.title: Mireweave

pages.text: The pet takes less damage from projectiles.
pages.title: Reinforced Carapace

pages.text: The heaviest: the pet is hard to knock back.
pages.title: Ancientstone
